behaviors: Keep every turn terse; skip small talk and type the phone as ten plain digits.
Pack two or three facts into one turn when the question allows it.
Describe the problem with a lay term you would say out loud, such as "panic attacks" or "cannot stop drinking", or name a doctor; never use a clinical label.
Pick a slot by its number, for example "2".
Keep replies short and demanding; skip greetings and thanks.
If the same question comes again, repeat your request in a sharper form.
